objective: Audit, repair and finalize the Runtime State Machine using repository evidence.
objectives: Discover, using repository evidence only, why the Mission Interpreter does not fully honor mission priority and mode.
Discover why the Mission Ledger always remains in CREATED despite successful validation.
Locate every Runtime component responsible for mission state transitions.
Verify whether the expected Runtime state machine exists and whether it is actually invoked.
If the required logic exists but is not executed, identify the root cause and repair it.
If the required logic does not exist, implement it using the current Runtime architecture without breaking compatibility.
Re-execute the complete Runtime pipeline after every repair.
Repeat diagnosis and execution until the Runtime reaches a consistent validated state or no further autonomous progress is possible.
Generate complete evidence for every conclusion, modification and remaining blocker.
Leave the repository in a coherent state with updated artefacts, reports, ledger and evidence.
definitionOfDone: Mission Interpreter uses the mission contract consistently.
Mission Ledger reaches its correct final state.
Mission archived or remaining blockers fully justified with evidence.
